title: John's Shopping Cart Race Car

voice.style: calm, friendly, a little playful, quick pace, neutral accent

scenes.name: Parking lot at sunset, John climbs in and pushes off
Too fast downhill, broom friction brake
Tips in a corner, potatoes lower the center of mass
Twist: nests into the cart row and gets pushed inside

lines.text: If you put John in a shopping cart, he has a race car. Sort of.
But one wheel always wobbles. So you tighten the loose wheel.
But pushing with your foot is way too slow. So you strap a leaf blower to the back.
But the front wheels just spin around, so it can't turn. So you add a steering rope.
But now it's too fast to stop. So you drag a broom behind it, and friction slows it down.
But it tips over in tight corners. So you put heavy potatoes low in the basket to keep it steady.
Congratulations, John has the fastest shopping cart in town.

placement_note: Each line can be split at a sentence break. Part N starts at its 'at' time (seconds), or right after the previous part if the voice runs long.
